title: ns3-ntn-toolkit: A Pre-Integrated ns-3 Platform for 6G Non-Terrestrial Network Research
description: Pre-integrated ns-3.43 distribution for 6G NTN research: SGP4 constellation propagation (SNS3), 3GPP TR 38.811 NTN channels, mmWave 5G-NR, Release-17 conditional handover with a Time-to-Exit trigger (ntn-cho), Space O-RAN with 13 xApps (oran-ntn), HITRAN-2024 sub-THz propagation (thz-ntn), NTN traffic models, and a modernised ns3-ai Gymnasium bridge. Includes the 10-seed Monte-Carlo CHO baseline and THz/O-RAN demonstrator datasets.
